# UPS-01 is commented out as of 2026-08-31.
#
# Its USB data cable was disconnected on 2026-08-28 during a UPS swap and is
# not plugged into any node. red-server now draws power from UPS-02, whose
# data cable is on grey-server and reports there as ups02.
#
# With no UPS attached, usbhid-ups failed and systemd restarted it every five
# seconds: 12,014 restarts and 75,292 journal lines in the 24 hours to
# 2026-08-31, which was also 62.9 per cent of all fleet Wazuh alerts on
# 2026-08-29. Commenting out the stanza is what actually stops it, because
# nut-driver-enumerator rebuilds the driver under an MD5-hashed instance name
# and therefore walks straight past a mask on nut-driver@ups01.service.

# below, then run
[Unit]

ExecStart=/usr/sbin/upsd -F

WantedBy=nut.target

PartOf=nut.target

p.write_text("---\n# Gives the six hosts that run the upstream node_exporter binary the same\n# textfile collector the twelve Debian-package hosts have had all along, so\n# every host in the fleet publishes apt_upgrades_pending (or\n# dnf_upgrades_pending) and node_reboot_required, and grey-server publishes\n# SMART and NVMe health like the other four nodes.\n#\n# The package-managed hosts got prometheus-node-exporter-collectors as a\n# Recommends of prometheus-node-exporter and never needed this. The binary\n# hosts had no /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter directory and no\n# --collector.textfile.directory flag, which is why the update alerts could\n# not see them.\n#\n# The collectors package is installed without Recommends on purpose. Its\n# Recommends include ipmitool, and ipmitool pulls in openipmi, whose service\n# fails at every boot on a machine with no BMC. None of these has one.\n#\n# Run with -e target=<host> for one host.\n- name: Enable textfile collectors on the binary-installed node_exporter hosts\n  hosts: \"{{ target | default('textfile_collector_targets') }}\"\n  gather_facts: true\n  become: true\n  vars:\n    textfile_dir: /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter\n    node_exporter_binary: /usr/local/bin/node_exporter\n    node_exporter_port: 9100\n    # Bare metal only. Inside a VM or LXC the SMART and NVMe scripts either\n    # see nothing or see the host's devices without permission to read them,\n    # and either way write a file that reports a fault which is not real.\n    hardware_collectors: \"{{ ansible_facts.virtualization_role | default('guest') == 'host' }}\"\n  environment:\n    DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive\n    NEEDRESTART_MODE: l\n\n  tasks:\n    - name: Confirm a supported package manager is present\n      ansible.builtin.assert:\n        that:\n          - ansible_facts.pkg_mgr in ['apt', 'dnf', 'dnf5']\n        fail_msg: \"Unsupported package manager '{{ ansible_facts.pkg_mgr }}' on {{ inventory_hostname }}.\"\n        quiet: true\n\n    # This play is for the binary hosts only. A Debian-package host already\n    # has the directory, the flag and the scripts, and its unit is called\n    # prometheus-node-exporter, so the drop-in below would be written for a\n    # unit that does not exist.\n    - name: Confirm this host runs the upstream node_exporter unit\n      ansible.builtin.stat:\n        path: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service\n      register: upstream_unit\n\n    - name: Stop when the host is not a binary-installed node_exporter\n      ansible.builtin.assert:\n        that:\n          - upstream_unit.stat.exists\n        fail_msg: >-\n          {{ inventory_hostname }} has no /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service.\n          It is either package-managed, in which case it already has a textfile\n          collector, or has no exporter at all.\n        quiet: true\n\n    - name: Create the textfile collector directory\n      ansible.builtin.file:\n        path: \"{{ textfile_dir }}\"\n        state: directory\n        owner: root\n        group: root\n        mode: \"0755\"\n\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------- Debian\n    - name: Install the collectors package without its Recommends\n      when: ansible_facts.pkg_mgr == 'apt'\n      ansible.builtin.apt:\n        name: prometheus-node-exporter-collectors\n        state: present\n        install_recommends: false\n        update_cache: true\n        cache_valid_time: 3600\n        # Debian 12 and Ubuntu 24.04 depend on the distro exporter too.\n        # Do not let a newly installed dependency claim the upstream port.\n        policy_rc_d: 101\n\n    - name: Discover package services after installing the collectors\n      when: ansible_facts.pkg_mgr == 'apt'\n      ansible.builtin.service_facts:\n\n    - name: Keep the distro exporter stopped on upstream-binary hosts\n      when:\n        - ansible_facts.pkg_mgr == 'apt'\n        - \"'prometheus-node-exporter.service' in ansible_facts.services\"\n      ansible.builtin.systemd_service:\n        name: prometheus-node-exporter.service\n        state: stopped\n        enabled: false\n        masked: true\n\n    -
